requirement_title: Lawful basis for processing with free, specific, informed consent
statement: Every consent request requires a clear affirmative action by the data principal; consent is never inferred from silence, a pre-ticked box, inactivity or continued use of the service.
evidence_hint: consent_forms (screenshots of every consent capture flow)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Lawful basis for processing with free, specific, informed consent
statement: Every consent request names the specified purpose(s) for which the personal data will be processed.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Lawful basis for processing with free, specific, informed consent
statement: The data principal is offered the option to read the consent request in English or in a language listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(3) [repo cites s.6(1)-(2); the language duty sits in s.6(3)]. How many Eighth Schedule languages must be offered is not settled by the text. 'Clear and plain language' is not tested: it is not binary
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Lawful basis for processing with free, specific, informed consent
statement: No consent request contains a term by which the data principal waives a right under the Act or agrees to processing that would breach the Act or another law.
evidence_hint: consent_forms; privacy_policy (terms linked from consent flows)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Lawful basis for processing with free, specific, informed consent
statement: Consent screens captured from the live web/app during the assessment period match the approved consent design (affirmative action, purpose stated, no pre-selected choices).
evidence_hint: consent_forms (dated live screenshots or screen recording)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Where one collection point serves more than one purpose, the consent request lists each purpose as a separate item rather than a single combined purpose.
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(1) ('specific'); DPDP Rules 2025 r.3(b)(ii) [repo cites s.6(3), which concerns language and contact details]. Per-purpose consent is a reading of 'specific', not express text
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: The accompanying notice gives an itemised description of the personal data processed for each listed purpose.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Sampled consent records store a consent status for each purpose separately, not one combined flag.
evidence_hint: consent log extract (sample of data principals)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: The notice or consent flow tells the data principal how to withdraw consent (link or described means).
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Withdrawing consent takes no more steps, and uses no less accessible a channel, than giving it did (e.g. consent given in-app can be withdrawn in-app).
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(4) [repo cites s.6(6)-(7); the withdrawal right sits in s.6(4), s.6(7) concerns Consent Managers]; DPDP Rules 2025 r.3(c)(i)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: A documented procedure makes the organisation stop the processing that relied on a withdrawn consent within a defined period, unless processing without consent is required or authorised by law.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: The withdrawal procedure requires the organisation to make its Data Processors stop processing that data principal's personal data.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: For a sample of withdrawals in the period, records show processing stopped (including at processors) within the defined period.
evidence_hint: withdrawal log sample; processor instruction records
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Every Consent Manager through which the organisation receives consents appears on the Data Protection Board's published list of registered Consent Managers.
evidence_hint: Consent Manager agreement; extract of the Board's published register
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(9); DPDP Rules 2025 r.4(2)(a). Registration is the Consent Manager's obligation; the fiduciary-side test is using only registered ones
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Consent Manager registration (Act s.6(9), Rules r.4) commences one year after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette, i.e. mid-Nov 2026; the fiduciary's own consent duties (s.6(1)-(8)) commence mid-May 2027.

statement: The organisation's systems accept consent given, reviewed or withdrawn through the Consent Manager and act on it the same way as consent given directly.
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(7). Whether a fiduciary must support Consent Managers at all, or only honour those it onboards, is not settled by the text
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: A reconciliation of Consent Manager records against internal consent status for a sample of data principals shows withdrawals made via the Consent Manager were applied.
evidence_hint: Consent Manager consent/withdrawal records; internal consent log extract
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Verifiable parental consent for children's data
statement: A documented process obtains a parent's verifiable consent before any personal data of a child (under 18) is processed, except processing covered by a Fourth Schedule exemption the organisation has recorded.
source_basis: DPDPA s.9(1), s.2(f); DPDP Rules 2025 r.10(1), r.12
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Verifiable parental consent for children's data
statement: The process checks that the person consenting as parent is an identifiable adult, using identity and age details already reliably held or details/virtual token from an authorised entity (e.g. a Digital Locker provider).
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Verifiable parental consent for children's data
statement: Where a lawful guardian consents for a person with disability, the process checks the guardian was appointed by a court, a designated authority or a local level committee.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Verifiable parental consent for children's data
statement: For a sample of child accounts, records show the parent's consent and the verification method used, dated before the child's data was first processed.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice at or before collection of personal data
statement: A notice is presented before or together with every consent request, not only linked from a site footer.
source_basis: DPDPA s.5(1) [repo says 'at or before collection'; the Act ties the notice to consent requests, not to data collected under a s.7 legitimate use]
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice at or before collection of personal data
statement: The notice itemises the personal data collected and states the specified purpose(s) and the goods, services or uses each purpose enables.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice at or before collection of personal data
statement: The notice gives a link (or describes another means) through which the data principal can withdraw consent and exercise her rights.
source_basis: DPDPA s.5(1)(ii); DPDP Rules 2025 r.3(c)(i)-(ii) [extends the repo description, which names only data and purpose, to the statutory minimum content]
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice at or before collection of personal data
statement: The notice describes how the data principal can complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
source_basis: DPDPA s.5(1)(iii); DPDP Rules 2025 r.3(c)(iii) [extends the repo description to the statutory minimum content]
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice at or before collection of personal data
statement: The notice can be read in English or, at the data principal's option, in a language listed in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution.
source_basis: DPDPA s.5(3). Number of languages required is not settled by the text
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: The organisation has identified the data principals whose personal data it processes on consent given before the Act's notice and consent provisions commenced.
source_basis: DPDPA s.5(2), s.1(2). 'Commencement' is read per provision (s.1(2)), i.e. consents given before mid-May 2027
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: A retrospective notice template states the personal data held, the purposes it has been processed for, how to withdraw consent and exercise rights, and how to complain to the Board.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Dispatch records (email, in-app or other channel) show the retrospective notice was sent to the identified data principals, with dates.
source_basis: DPDPA s.5(2)(a) ('as soon as reasonably practicable'); what counts as timely after commencement is untested
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice contains contact details of DPO or grievance officer
statement: Each consent request gives contact details of the DPO (if an SDF) or of a person authorised to respond to data principals exercising their rights.
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(3) [repo cites s.5(1); the contact-details duty sits in s.6(3), s.8(9) and Rules r.9]. 'DPO' is defined only for SDFs (s.2(l)); 'grievance officer' is not an Act term
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice contains contact details of DPO or grievance officer
statement: The business contact information of the DPO, or of a person who can answer data principals' questions about processing, is prominently published on the website or app.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Notice contains contact details of DPO or grievance officer
statement: A sample of responses to rights requests in the period includes that business contact information.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: A processing record (ROPA or data inventory) links every processing activity to either a specified purpose in a consent notice or a named s.7 legitimate use.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Sampled processing activities (e.g. a marketing campaign, an analytics use, a data share) each map to a purpose in the notice under which consent was taken, or to a recorded s.7 basis.
evidence_hint: data_flow_diagram; consent_forms; campaign or data-share records
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Legitimate uses without consent properly identified
statement: A register lists each processing activity carried out without consent and names the specific s.7 clause relied on (e.g. s.7(a) voluntary provision, s.7(i) employment).
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Legitimate uses without consent properly identified
statement: For each s.7(a) use, the register records the purpose for which the data was voluntarily provided and how the data principal's indication that she does not consent stops the use.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Legitimate uses without consent properly identified
statement: No register entry relies on a ground that is not in s.7 (e.g. 'legitimate interests' or 'contractual necessity' in the GDPR sense).
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Collection limited to what is necessary
statement: Each personal data field collected on the basis of consent is mapped to the specified purpose that needs it.
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(1) (consent limited to data necessary for the purpose) [repo cites s.4(1)]. The Act has no general minimisation duty for s.7 uses
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Collection limited to what is necessary
statement: Sampled collection forms or API payloads contain no field that the mapping marks as unnecessary or omits.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Data retention limited to purpose fulfilment
statement: The retention procedure requires erasure when consent is withdrawn or when it is reasonable to assume the specified purpose is no longer served, whichever comes first, unless a named law requires retention.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Data retention limited to purpose fulfilment
statement: The procedure requires Data Processors to erase personal data the organisation made available to them when erasure is triggered.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Data retention limited to purpose fulfilment
statement: If the organisation is an e-commerce entity or social media intermediary with at least 2 crore registered users in India, or an online gaming intermediary with at least 50 lakh, the procedure erases a user's data after three years without her approaching it or exercising rights (excluding account and virtual-token access).
source_basis: DPDPA s.8(8); DPDP Rules 2025 r.8(1), Third Schedule
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Data retention limited to purpose fulfilment
statement: For organisations in the Third Schedule classes, the procedure warns the data principal at least 48 hours before inactivity-based erasure.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Data retention limited to purpose fulfilment
statement: Erasure job logs or erasure records for the period show personal data past its erasure trigger was actually erased.
evidence_hint: retention_policy; deletion job logs / erasure records sample
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: A retention schedule sets a retention period or erasure trigger for each personal data category or processing purpose.
source_basis: DPDPA s.8(7); the schedule document itself is practice
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: Where the schedule keeps data after its purpose is served, it names the law that requires the retention.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: No schedule period erases personal data, associated traffic data or processing logs sooner than one year after the processing, unless another law requires otherwise.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Retention or deletion settings on a sample of systems holding personal data match the schedule's periods.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Reasonable efforts to ensure data accuracy
statement: The organisation has identified the processing in which personal data is used to make a decision affecting the data principal or is disclosed to another Data Fiduciary.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Reasonable efforts to ensure data accuracy
statement: For that processing, documented controls check the data's completeness, accuracy and consistency (e.g. validation at capture, source reconciliation) before it is used or disclosed.
source_basis: DPDPA s.8(3) [repo says 'reasonable efforts'; the Act says the fiduciary 'shall ensure' completeness, accuracy and consistency, but only for decision-making or onward disclosure]
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Reasonable efforts to ensure data accuracy
statement: Records for the period show the checks ran (e.g. validation-failure reports or data-quality review logs) and flagged errors were corrected.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: The security policy covers all personal data the organisation holds or controls, including data processed for it by Data Processors.
source_basis: DPDPA s.8(5) [repo cites s.8(4); the security-safeguards duty sits in s.8(5)]; DPDP Rules 2025 r.6(1)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Access to personal data is logged, and the logs are monitored and reviewed so unauthorised access can be detected, investigated and remediated.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Backups or equivalent measures let processing continue if personal data is destroyed or access to it is lost.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Access logs and the personal data needed to investigate unauthorised access are kept for at least one year, unless another law requires otherwise.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Log-review records for the period show that reviews of access to personal data actually took place and anomalies were followed up.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Personal data is protected by at least one of encryption, obfuscation, masking or tokenisation.
source_basis: DPDP Rules 2025 r.6(1)(a) [repo requires encryption specifically; the Rules accept any of the four measures]
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Personal data sent over networks is encrypted in transit.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: Access to the computer resources holding personal data is restricted to authorised users through defined access controls.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Access rights to personal data are granted on a least-privilege, need-to-know basis.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: An access review of systems holding personal data was completed in the last 12 months and removed access no longer needed.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: Every Data Processor that processes personal data for the organisation is engaged under a signed contract.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Each Data Processor contract requires the processor to take reasonable security safeguards.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Each Data Processor contract requires the processor to stop processing and to erase personal data when the organisation instructs it to.
source_basis: DPDPA s.6(6), s.8(7)(b) (fiduciary must cause processors to cease and erase; a contract term is the usual means, not an express requirement)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Each Data Processor contract limits the processor to processing on the organisation's behalf and instructions.
source_basis: DPDPA s.2(k), s.8(1); the explicit instructions term is practice
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: Every processor in the organisation's processor/vendor register has a current signed contract on file (sample reconciliation).
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Summary of personal data and processing activities
statement: The website or app publishes how a data principal can request information about her personal data and which identifier she must give.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Summary of personal data and processing activities
statement: The access-request response template includes a summary of the personal data processed and of the processing activities.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Summary of personal data and processing activities
statement: The response template names all other Data Fiduciaries and Data Processors the data was shared with and describes what was shared (subject to the s.11(2) law-enforcement carve-out).
evidence_hint: access request procedure; response template; vendor_agreements

statement: The procedure requires a detailed follow-up report to the Board within 72 hours of becoming aware of the breach, or within a longer period the Board allows on a written request.
source_basis: DPDP Rules 2025 r.7(2)(b) [the 72-hour period comes from the Rules; Act s.8(6) sets no timeline]
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Breach notification to Data Protection Board
statement: The Board report template covers updated details of the breach, its facts and causes, mitigation measures, findings on who caused it, measures to prevent recurrence, and a report of the intimations sent to data principals.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Breach notification to Data Protection Board
statement: The procedure applies to every personal data breach as defined in the Act, with no harm or materiality threshold for intimating the Board.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Breach notification to Data Protection Board
statement: For each personal data breach in the period, records show the initial intimation and the detailed report reached the Board on time.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Breach notification to affected Data Principals
statement: The breach procedure requires intimating each affected data principal without delay, through her user account or a communication channel she registered.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Breach notification to affected Data Principals
statement: The data principal notification template covers the breach's nature, extent and timing; likely consequences for her; mitigation measures taken; steps she can take; and a contact for queries.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Breach notification to affected Data Principals
statement: The procedure notifies every affected data principal, with no risk or harm threshold.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

requirement_title: Breach notification to affected Data Principals
statement: For each personal data breach in the period, records show affected data principals were sent a notification containing the template content.
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: An approved incident response plan covers detection, containment, investigation, notification and remediation of personal data breaches.
source_basis: practice (supports DPDPA s.8(5); DPDP Rules 2025 r.6(1)(c), r.7)
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: The plan names the roles that decide a breach has occurred and that send the Board and data principal intimations.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: The plan includes a method for identifying affected data principals and their registered contact channels.
source_basis: DPDP Rules 2025 r.7(1) (needed to notify each affected data principal)
in_force_note: Not in force at 2026-09-25. Commences 18 months after the 13 Nov 2025 Gazette (Act: G.S.R. 843(E) cl.(c); Rules: r.1(4)), i.e. mid-May 2027.

statement: The plan was exercised (tabletop or real incident) in the last 12 months and lessons were recorded.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: A breach register records each personal data breach with its facts, effects and remedial actions.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: Each register entry records when the Board and the affected data principals were intimated.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).

statement: Every personal data breach in the security incident log for the period appears in the breach register.
in_force_note: Practice, not a statutory duty. The related Act/Rules provisions commence mid-May 2027 (not in force at 2026-09-25).
